historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly requires outlet mapping and complete evidence. This review makes outlet/exhaust coordinate, airflow role and inlet-to-outlet context explicit.

original_test_intent: Validate TEMP_MB_OUTLET as the approved motherboard outlet/exhaust-zone measurement and prove its exact name, description and reading consistently across complete IB/OOB SDR, complete IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web.
original_method: The mechanical/thermal owner identifies the probe coordinate and whether it represents exhaust air or a local downstream board hotspot, supplies condition-specific limits and expected descriptions; automation captures complete passive same-target evidence.
manual_activity: The thermal owner locates the outlet probe, defines its exhaust/board-zone meaning and operating-condition limits, and confirms the Web entry. No load, airflow or fan change is authorized.
required_inputs: Motherboard/chassis drawing with exact outlet probe coordinate and orientation
Approved meaning as exhaust/reference outlet or downstream board hotspot
Expected SDR name/entity/description and Sensor List/Web mapping
Units, scale, tolerance, polling/freshness and unavailable semantics
Approved range/state under documented ambient, load, fan and airflow direction
Expected inlet-to-outlet delta if used, with matching inlet reference and limits
Same-target IB/OOB identity plus BMC/SDR/board/spec revisions
Secret-safe complete collectors and independent cooling/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Prove IB and OOB address the same system and compare the same outlet record
Retain complete SDR and Sensor List; grep outlet is only a derived view
Do not assume OUTLET means chassis exhaust or reuse inlet limits without physical confirmation
Record ambient/load/fan/airflow context before judging the value or delta
Do not create load, obstruct/reverse airflow, change fans/thresholds, reset BMC or clear logs
Stop on missing/stale/invalid outlet data, unsafe temperature/delta, path mismatch or BMC instability; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify source, physical outlet semantics and same-target IB/OOB identity
Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List inventories plus exact outlet result
Prepare Web evidence and passive inlet/outlet/fan/ambient context
Perform no workload, airflow/fan/threshold change or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve outlet coordinate and airflow semantics
Provide operating-condition range, thresholds and any delta criterion
Confirm Web mapping and cross-path parity
Review outlet evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The exact OOB query is only one source-required view; it omits IB, Sensor List and Web, truncates SDR and exposes credentials.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use secret-safe same-target IB/OOB sessions to retain complete SDR and Sensor List, extract the approved outlet record, and compare its BMC Web entry with documented airflow context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TEMP_MB_OUTLET, four command views, Web and 3/3-minute estimates remain; coordinate and limits are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES OUTLET LOCATION, AIRFLOW CRITERIA AND CROSS-PATH PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the outlet record to a physical airflow coordinate and reconcile complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and Web values under documented conditions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds physical exhaust/board-zone meaning, same-target parity and optional owner-defined inlet/outlet context.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One OOB exact query or an inlet temperature cannot satisfy the complete cross-path outlet check.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A probe inside a recirculation pocket can read much hotter than exhaust air, so mislabeled location can generate false cooling verdicts.

project_override_considerations: Reverse-airflow and liquid-cooled variants must supply their own outlet definition. If no meaningful exhaust-air probe exists, the owner must classify the board-zone interpretation explicitly instead of applying a generic chassis delta.
expected_evidence: Mechanical outlet coordinate/orientation and airflow-role evidence
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List outputs
Value, units, freshness, enabled thresholds and operating-condition limits
BMC Web entry plus ambient/inlet/outlet/fan/SEL context
Same-target proof, statuses and artifact hashes

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row consistently targets TEMP_MB_OUTLET across IB/OOB and Web. Undefined coordinate and numeric criteria are readiness inputs rather than contradictory instructions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A passive outlet check is identifiable; physical semantics and limits are supplyable under ED-36.

review_improvement: Restores all source-required views and adds physical outlet/airflow provenance so the result is not confused with inlet air or a generic board hotspot.
independent_technical_reasoning: Outlet temperature depends on probe position relative to heat sources, mixing and exhaust flow. A downstream board sensor and true exhaust-air probe can differ substantially even on the same motherboard. Cross-path record parity prevents IB/OOB naming inconsistencies, while full inventories ensure an outlet grep has not hidden duplicate or stale records.
